summary.name: Cleaner One Pro - Uninstaller
summary.one_liner: A Mac cleaner app from Trend Micro that removes junk files, finds duplicate and large files, manages installed apps, and sorts photos, sold on the Mac App Store.
use_cases: Free up disk space on a Mac
Find and delete duplicate files or photos
Locate large files taking up storage
Completely uninstall apps and remove leftover files
Clean temporary files, logs and trash
summary.what_it_does: Cleaner One Pro scans a Mac for junk files such as logs, mail caches, and temporary files, and can empty the trash for the current user. Its duplicate scanner matches files by content as well as name and lets the user send duplicates to Trash or delete them permanently (the latter requires in-app purchase). The photo manager finds similar, blurry, and screenshot images. The app manager lists installed applications by size and last opened date and detects leftover files from deleted apps. A big files scanner, a color-coded disk map, and real-time CPU and network monitoring are also included.
notable: Disk map that shows files color-coded by type and size
Duplicates detected by file content, not just name
Quick Disk Clean accessible from the status bar menu
Free to download with in-app purchases
caveats: Permanent deletion of duplicates, app uninstall extras, vulnerability scan and some monitoring details require in-app purchase
Paid version listed from $19.99 per year, price may vary by location; subscription auto-renews
